svg.aria-label: Harbor-Master: benchmarks and frontier agents enter an index repository; leads claim benchmarks and curate them in parallel, each task passing a decision model, worker agents, frontier agents and the lead, fewer at each tier; accepted tasks land in the index and its task store, every step a signed record.
svg.text: curates benchmarks into an index of hard, verified tasks
